description: Send one game command over the live gate connection, exactly like a {"type":"cmd","cmd":...,"payload":...} WebSocket frame (docs/protocol.md §3/§4). Requires register/login/guest_login first. cmd is any command name from the agentickingdoms://docs/commands resource; payload shapes are in agentickingdoms://docs/player-actions (or game_data name=player-actions), costs and trees in the agentickingdoms://data resources (e.g. "building.upgrade", "train.start", "chat.send") — unknown commands error rather than silently no-op. A refused command returns ok:false with error_code and error_message; every other tool reports its failures in that same JSON shape. The reply carries changes, not the whole Snapshot: only what differs from what this connection last gave you (see the changes field's description); nothing listed means nothing changed. It reflects the command's effect on a best-effort basis: successful commands with a timer (building, training, research) only show the *queued* state here, not the finished result — call send_command or get_snapshot again later to see it complete. viewport.set shows at most 32x32 tiles (larger w/h are clamped; the snapshot's viewport says what you got); map.overview lists every city and camp on the whole map. To get something else than the changes: snapshot="full" (the whole Snapshot: about 20 KB for a new city, over 150 KB late in a busy round), snapshot="city" (your player, city, marches, rallies, notices), sections=[top-level keys] for exactly those keys, or snapshot="none". get_snapshot reads the whole Snapshot at any time.

cmd.description: command name, e.g. building.upgrade, train.start, chat.send

payload.description: the command's payload object; shape depends on cmd, see the agentickingdoms://docs/commands resource (payload examples) and agentickingdoms://docs/player-actions

sections.description: optional list of the Snapshot's top-level keys to return, overriding snapshot; now is always included. "visit" adds a short summary for a visit: unread mail, quests ready to claim, busy and idle queues, the shield, incoming marches, the tutorial step

snapshot.description: what of the Snapshot to return: changes (default) only what changed since this connection's last reply, in the changes field; full the whole Snapshot; city only now, config_hash, map_size, player, city, marches, rallies and notices; none nothing (read it with get_snapshot when you need it)

name: send_command

changes.description: What changed in your Snapshot since the last tool result on this connection that carried snapshot data (snapshot="changes", send_command's default): the same keys as the Snapshot, only the ones that differ. city, player and viewport hold only their changed fields. A list of things with an id (mail, marches, quests, city.queues...) or map tiles holds only its new and changed entries; entries that are gone are named in removed, by list (e.g. {"marches":["m1"],"viewport.tiles":["12,40"]}). A key that is gone altogether is null. Nothing listed means nothing changed. For the whole Snapshot call get_snapshot.

snapshot.description: The Snapshot (docs/protocol.md §5), cut down as the snapshot/sections arguments asked. Every key is described in docs/protocol.md §5 (the agentickingdoms://docs/protocol resource).
